name: Report to Goldshire

angles.text: Graduating from Northshire into the service of Goldshire marks a human adventurer's first official recognition by the Stormwind military hierarchy.
With Stormwind's army diverted elsewhere, the defense of Elwynn relies increasingly on newly deputized local recruits and volunteers.

faq.answer: Marshal Dughan is the commanding officer of the Stormwind Marshals stationed in Goldshire, responsible for managing the defense and patrols across Elwynn Forest.

After handling immediate threats within the quiet valley of Northshire Valley, Marshal McBride reassigns capable recruits southward to Goldshire to assist with the much broader dangers threatening Elwynn Forest.
faq.q: Why are recruits sent to Goldshire?

faq.answer: Acting Deputy Status is a provisional field rank granted by Marshal McBride's documents, inducting promising recruits into the ranks of the Stormwind Marshals to assist local law enforcement.
faq.q: What does Acting Deputy Status mean?

faq.answer: According to Marshal Dughan, most of Stormwind's standing army is diverted away, tied up on errands and duties dictated by court nobles rather than patrolling local settlements.
Marshal McBride oversees the garrison at Northshire Abbey, training new defenders before sending those who prove themselves to the front line at Goldshire.
Goldshire lies down the main road leading south out of Northshire Valley, past the boundary gates and into the heart of Elwynn Forest.
faq.q: How do you find Goldshire from Northshire?

sections.body: Having proven their mettle against local troubles within Northshire Valley, recruits are officially released from Northshire's local guard by Marshal McBride. In recognition of their service, McBride prepares transfer papers directing them south past the border gates along the road into Goldshire, transferring their responsibilities to the wider expanse of Elwynn Forest.
sections.title: From Northshire to the Greater Forest

sections.body: Upon arrival in Goldshire, Marshal Dughan accepts McBride's dispatches and formally assigns the recruit the rank of Acting Deputy within the Stormwind Marshals. Yet Dughan's welcome comes with a grim warning: Northshire is a peaceful garden compared to the dangers roaming Elwynn, especially with Stormwind's royal army tied up in political maneuvering for distant nobles rather than protecting home ground.
sections.title: The Burden of the Marshals

summary: Report to Goldshire marks an adventurer's formal transition from the sheltered grounds of Northshire Valley into the broader jurisdiction of Elwynn Forest. Bearing dispatches from Marshal McBride to Marshal Dughan, recruits are granted Acting Deputy Status amid growing regional neglect from Stormwind's nobility.
attribution: In-game quest text: Report to Goldshire
